shortDescription: Autonomously shepherd GitHub pull requests through merge.
longDescription: PR Completion validates and commits task changes, creates pull requests, repairs CI and conflicts, and triages CodeRabbit, Codex, and human feedback. Invoking completion authorizes protected landing through verified merge. It reuses one watcher, relies on automatic incremental reviews after pushes, and obtains effective approval after findings are handled. Fresh readiness and a head race guard preserve GitHub protections without repeated user approval prompts. It never uses admin bypass, force-push, history rewriting, or direct merge APIs.
authentication: Uses the user's existing local GitHub CLI authentication; the plugin operates no credential service and stores no credentials.
dataHandling: Runs locally with no plugin-operated backend or telemetry. Repository and pull-request data is sent only through tools the user invokes, principally GitHub via gh.
